scenarios.name: Switch tabs with a floating command panel open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected
the user selects the Annotate tab on the floating ribbon
the ribbon displays Geometric Annotation, General Annotation, Notes, Manage, and Tolerance Analysis groups
the user selects the Notes group
an adjacent panel displays Leader Text, General Note, and General Profile Note commands
the user selects the 3D Model tab
the floating ribbon displays its 3D Model groups again
